connector.name: Safe Kaggle MCP
connector.registryDescription: Safety-first Kaggle MCP - confirm-gated destructive ops, submission budget, injection-fenced.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package safe-kaggle-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the parkseokjune account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KAGGLE_USERNAME
env.description: Kaggle account username (legacy scheme; pair with KAGGLE_KEY). Optional — read-only tools work without credentials.

env.name: KAGGLE_KEY
env.description: Kaggle API key, the 40-char 'key' from kaggle.json (legacy scheme; pair with KAGGLE_USERNAME).

env.name: KAGGLE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Modern Kaggle KGAT_... token (alternative to KAGGLE_USERNAME/KAGGLE_KEY). Optional.

env.name: KAGGLE_MCP_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE
env.description: Set to 1 to expose delete tools. Default 0 (off).

env.name: KAGGLE_MCP_ENABLE_PUBLISH
env.description: Set to 1 to allow making datasets/kernels public. Default 0 (off).
